map.计算数值的百分比、占比、增长率等: Compute percentage, proportion, growth rate, etc. of a value
map.剩余百分比 = 收汁后量 ÷ 收汁前量 × 100%；浓缩倍数 = 收汁前量 ÷: Remaining percentage = post-reduction amount ÷ pre-reduction amount × 100%; concentration factor = pre-reduction amount ÷ post-reduction amount; change = new − old, change rate = (new − old) ÷ old × 100%; general proportion = total × percentage ÷ 100; braise until 60%–70% remaining for thick sauce coating the spoon, 40%–50% for sweet-and-sour reduction standard; when more than half reduced, switch to low heat to avoid scorching.
map.和面或腌渍时按面粉/肉重: When kneading dough or curing, add water and seasoning by flour / meat weight
map.加水和调料（如面粉 50% 水量、肉 2% 盐），保证每次配方稳定可复制。: (e.g. 50% flour water, 2% meat salt) to keep each recipe stable and reproducible.
map.核算菜品成本与出成率：用净料重÷毛料重得出料率，比较不同采购规格的划算程度。: Check dish cost and yield rate: use net weight ÷ gross weight for yield rate, compare cost-effectiveness of different purchase specs.
map.减糖减盐配方调试：按原重百分比等比例下调糖盐，记录调整前后数值，便于回头复刻。: Low-sugar low-salt recipe tuning: lower sugar and salt proportionally by original-weight percentage, record before/after values, easy to recreate.
map.面粉 500g，加水量按 50% 计为 250g（约 250ml）；盐 1% 即: Flour 500g, water at 50% = 250g (about 250ml); salt 1% = 5g. After converting to percentage, any flour amount can be scaled by ratio, dough consistency stays the same.
map.中式烹饪多以主食材重（如面粉、肉）或总重为 100%，调料按其百分比计；统一基数: Chinese cooking mostly takes the main ingredient weight (flour, meat) or total weight as 100%, seasonings by their percentage; a unified base enables horizontal comparison of different recipes.
map.出成率 = 净料重 ÷ 毛料重 × 100%；如土豆去皮后 800g / 毛重: Yield rate = net weight ÷ gross weight × 100%; e.g. potato after peeling 800g / gross 1000g = 80%, for cost and usage estimate.
map.腌肉加盐 2% 是通用值吗？: Is 2% salt for cured meat a general value?
map.家常腌肉约 1–2% 盐（占肉重），酱肉、腊肉更高；具体按口味与保存需求调整，本: Home-cured meat about 1–2% salt (of meat weight), more for soy-cured and bacon; adjust by taste and preservation need; this tool only does percentage conversion.
